about: Every file the game ships from public/assets. Each entry names the pack it came from, its licence, and how it was prepared. Run `npm run sync-art` after changing this list; `npm run build` refuses files that are not listed here.

sprites-premium.name: Sprout Lands - Sprites - Premium pack
sprites-premium.creator: Cup Nooble
sprites-premium.license: Sprout Lands Premium licence (paid). Commercial and non-commercial use allowed, modification allowed. The pack itself may not be resold or redistributed. No NFTs or AI training. Credit required.
sprites-premium.credit: Assets from Sprout Lands by Cup Nooble
evidence: itch.io page: 'Premium version license (paying at least $3.99): This asset pack can be used in any commercial or non-commercial project'
Owner confirmed the paid Premium pack was purchased (2026-09-28)

ui-premium.name: Sprout Lands - UI Pack - Premium pack
ui-premium.folder: Sprout Lands - UI Pack - Premium pack/Sprout Lands - UI Pack - Premium pack
ui-premium.creator: Cup Nooble
ui-premium.license: Sprout Lands Premium UI licence (paid). Commercial and non-commercial use allowed, modification allowed. The pack itself may not be resold or redistributed. No NFTs or AI training. Credit required.
ui-premium.credit: UI from Sprout Lands UI Pack by Cup Nooble
evidence: itch.io page: 'Premium version license (paying at least $3.99): This asset pack can be used in any commercial or non-commercial project'
Owner confirmed the paid Premium UI pack was purchased (2026-09-28)

sorry-pack.name: Sprout Lands - Sorry pack (free gift)
sorry-pack.creator: Cup Nooble
sorry-pack.license: The bundled read_me.txt repeats the Basic (non-commercial) wording, but the creator has publicly confirmed on the itch.io page that the Sorry pack may be used in commercial games, as long as the pack itself is not resold or redistributed. Credit required.
sorry-pack.credit: Extra art from the Sprout Lands Sorry pack by Cup Nooble
evidence: itch.io comment reply by Cup Nooble to Tommy7heCat (about 133 days before 2026-09-28): 'yes it can' (commercial projects)
itch.io comment reply by Cup Nooble to roytt (about 202 days before 2026-09-28): 'yes, you can use the sorry pack in a commercial game'
Checked on https://cupnooble.itch.io/sorry-package on 2026-09-28. For extra certainty, ask Cup Nooble for written confirmation (Discord: cup_nooble).

generated-characters.name: Generated Characters (project-owned)
generated-characters.creator: Commissioned for this project (image generation guided by Sprout Lands style)
generated-characters.license: Project-owned original character sheets made for this game. See Generated Characters/README.md for how they were made.

made-art.name: Made Art (pictures redrawn for this game from the packs above)
made-art.creator: Made for this game by its scripts, from Cup Nooble's Sprout Lands art
made-art.license: Derived from the Sprout Lands Premium pack (modification allowed by its licence). Same terms as that pack: do not resell or redistribute the pictures on their own. Credit Cup Nooble.
made-art.credit: Assets from Sprout Lands by Cup Nooble
evidence: Made Art/README.md says which script makes each file and from which pack picture

halloween-art.name: Halloween pictures (made with ChatGPT for this game)
halloween-art.creator: Made for this game's owner with ChatGPT image generation, then cut and cleaned by the game's scripts
halloween-art.license: Project-owned pictures made for this game (ChatGPT image generation, Sprout Lands style). Check the image tool's terms before selling.
evidence: Made Art/halloween/ holds the original ChatGPT sheets and cut_sheet.py; scripts/tools/make-halloween-art.py cleans and packs them

made-sounds.name: Made Sounds (every sound effect, made for this game from scratch)
made-sounds.creator: Made for this game by scripts/tools/make-sounds.py (built from simple waves and noise; no recordings)
made-sounds.license: Owned by this game: made from scratch by its own script, no outside sounds used.
evidence: py scripts/tools/make-sounds.py writes every file in Made Sounds/

excludedPacks.Sprout Lands - UI Pack - Basic pack: Free Basic licence is non-commercial. Everything useful in it is also in the paid Premium UI pack, so nothing is taken from here.
excludedPacks.Sprout-Lands-Tilemap-0.2.0: Godot add-on. Its code is MIT (ideas only, nothing copied); its art is the free Basic pack (non-commercial). Nothing is taken from here.
excludedPacks.Sprout-Lands-UI-0.2.0: Godot add-on. MIT code plus free Basic UI art. Nothing is taken from here.
